# Chainlink VRF v2 — Deprecated

Chainlink VRF v2 is deprecated. Use Chainlink VRF v2.5 instead.

For new development, use the replacement documentation. Do not use the deprecated product's APIs, code examples, or setup instructions.

- [Chainlink VRF v2.5 documentation](https://docs.chain.link/vrf/v2-5/migration-from-v2.md)
- [Chainlink VRF v2.5 documentation index](https://docs.chain.link/vrf/llms.txt)
